messages:
rachel-sales: Heads up 1 — Caduceus (healthcare payer) asked for an executive bridge. CISO insists on BYO KMS, private peering, and a pilot SLA (min throughput + p99). They also want an updated pilot price if we reserve capacity. Need a one-page blockers summary before 09:30 PT.
omar-se: Clarify whether SLA = hard p99 latency or a committed throughput window. Pricing and rollback plan depend on that.
li-engineering: Quick infra note: BYO KMS can work via our customer-wrapped keyflow, but we need attestation for key usage and an onboarding window for certs. Peering requires CIDR plan, BGP session setup, and MTU checks. Ballpark config time: 48-72 hours for basic peering, 3-5 business days if legal attestation + HSM proofs required.
maria-legal: If they keep custody of keys, legal will need a KMS addendum and to confirm log export/access. Also check whether they want any privileged access for debugging (that changes liability). Please capture exact questionnaire items.
ty-cs: I'll prepare the POC options slide: Option A (fast): our KMS + peering, ~48h, minimal legal. Option B (BYO KMS + peering): 3-5 business days + addendum. I'll include a small ops uplift % for BYO.
bridge-bot: Exec bridge scheduled 2026-06-10 09:30 PT 1 invitees: rachel-sales, omar-se, li-engineering, maria-legal, ty-cs, caduceus-ciso. Link created.
rachel-sales: Owners: Omar = pricing delta (due 08:45), Li = infra diagrams + runbook (due 08:45), Maria = legal notes on KMS (due 08:15), Ty = POC slide + cost variance (due 08:30). I'll assemble the one-pager at 09:00 and post to the bridge channel.
omar-se: Quick ballpark: reserved capacity (monthly commit pro-rated) is ~30-40% cheaper for steady load; for short pilots we can offer -20% incentive to convert. I'll add sample numbers for a 30-day pilot at 50 rps.
li-engineering: Will attach a minimal verification snippet for BGP + perf checks and a simple failover plan to hosted endpoints if peering degrades.
maria-legal: I'll mark any questionnaire items that force contract changes and flag for exec approval.
ty-cs: I'll run a micro workload to capture latency and token-cost delta and include a slide.
rachel-sales: Thanks team. Keep updates in-thread and ping me for blockers.
